criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Information Query: General
categories.definition: User asks for facts, definitions, explanations, general knowledge, recommendations, or translations on various topics.

categories.name: Information Query: How-To & Instructions
categories.definition: User asks for steps, procedures, or advice on how to perform a task or solve a problem.

categories.name: Information Query: Personal Data
categories.definition: User asks for specific personal information stored or managed by the assistant, such as financial details, time off, or schedule.

categories.name: Information Query: Contextual
categories.definition: User asks for information specific to a current context, such as weather, traffic, time, or details about their vehicle, food, or financial products.

categories.name: Financial Account Management
categories.definition: User requests actions to manage their financial accounts, such as setting up direct deposit, blocking a card, or reporting fraud.

categories.name: Financial Transaction
categories.definition: User requests to perform a financial transaction, such as transferring funds, making a payment, or rolling over an account.

categories.name: Scheduling & Reservations
categories.definition: User requests to create, check, confirm, or cancel appointments or reservations.

categories.name: List Management
categories.definition: User requests to add, remove, read, create, clear, or check items on a list.

categories.name: Assistant Control
categories.definition: User requests to change how the assistant operates, such as repeating speech, adjusting volume, or changing language.

categories.name: Assistant Personalization
categories.definition: User requests to change how the assistant refers to them or itself.

categories.name: Assistant Information Query
categories.definition: User asks questions about the assistant's identity, origin, or capabilities.

categories.name: Device Connection & Sync
categories.definition: User requests to connect, pair, or synchronize the assistant with a device, or to disconnect.

categories.name: Locate Item
categories.definition: User requests to find a lost physical item or determine the location of a person.

categories.name: Media Interaction
categories.definition: User requests to search for, play, identify, or manage media content.

categories.name: Shopping & Ordering
categories.definition: User requests to purchase an item or search for products to buy.

categories.name: Status Update
categories.definition: User asks for the current status of an ongoing process, application, order, or physical item.

categories.name: Travel Planning & Search
categories.definition: User requests to search for travel options like flights, hotels, or public transport schedules.

categories.name: Utility & Randomization
categories.definition: User requests a simple utility function or a random outcome.

categories.name: Web Search
categories.definition: User explicitly asks the assistant to perform a web search for a query.

categories.name: Car Problem Diagnosis
categories.definition: User describes a car problem and seeks initial diagnosis or advice.

categories.name: Device Control: Smart Home
categories.definition: User requests to control a smart home device or appliance.

categories.name: Location Sharing
categories.definition: User requests to share their current location with another person.

categories.name: Note Management
categories.definition: User requests to manage a note, such as marking it as important.
